metrics.ttfb: Request-level time to first byte in ms: dns + tcp + tls + firstByte. Headline metric.
metrics.firstByte: Globalping's firstByte in ms: established TCP/TLS connection to first response byte. Excludes dns, tcp, tls.
metrics.total: Full request time in ms, including download.
metrics.dns: DNS lookup time in ms (null when the target was an IP).
metrics.tcp: TCP connect time in ms, measured from the end of the DNS lookup.
metrics.tls: TLS handshake time in ms, measured from the open TCP connection.
metrics.download: Time from first byte to end of body in ms.
metrics.availability: Share of samples that returned a 2xx/3xx status, over up + down samples. Indeterminate samples (Globalping resolver/internal failures) are excluded.
metrics.p50: Median over up samples in the window.
metrics.p95: 95th percentile (nearest rank) over up samples in the window.
metrics.http3: 'advertised' if any Alt-Svc header in the last 7 days contained an h3 token; 'not-advertised' if headers were seen without one; 'unknown' otherwise. Globalping does not make HTTP/3 requests, so this is never a measured value.
metrics.httpVersion: HTTP version parsed from the response status line, most common in the last 7 days. Requests ask for HTTP2 over TLS; the server may negotiate HTTP/1.1.
